shared_elements: human face/head with eyes, nose and mouth
representation of the human figure (head only in A; full figures in B)
justification: The only shared content is the human face: A is an isolated, massive schematic head with sunken eyes, a broad ridge nose and a heavy slit mouth, while B shows a procession of small full-length figures in strict profile leading horned rams within a framed register above a petal border. There is no shared relationship, arrangement or rendering convention: A is a single frontal, blocky, sculptural head with no scene, whereas B is a detailed, naturalistic narrative frieze with animals, garments, patterned caps and fleece infill.
